map.输入训练负荷(rTSS)、计划恢复时间与个人适应系数，基于超量恢复模型计算峰值时: Enter training load (rTSS), planned recovery time, and your personal adaptation coefficient to compute peak time, current recovery phase, and the best time for the next session based on the supercompensation model, helping you plan training rhythm scientifically.
map.+ k · rTSS · adapt（k 为个人系数）: + k · rTSS · adapt (k is the personal coefficient)
map.基于超量恢复模型：训练负荷 rTSS 越大、个人适应系数 adapt 越高，达到: Based on the supercompensation model: the larger the training load (rTSS) and the higher the personal adaptation coefficient (adapt), the later the time to peak performance (t*); the current recovery phase is used to determine the best time for the next session.
map.💡 超量恢复：训练后疲劳先升后降，体能越过基线形成超量恢复峰，再回落。峰值时间: 💡 Supercompensation: after training, fatigue rises then falls, and fitness rises above baseline to form a supercompensation peak before declining. Peak time t_peak ≈ ln(4)/(0.03 x adaptation coefficient); the larger the load and the slower the adaptation, the later the peak. Training near the peak yields the best stacking effect.
map.rTSS 为训练负荷评分，强度课约 80~150，长距离可达 200~300: rTSS is the training load score: about 80-150 for an intense session, up to 200-300 for long distance
map.适应系数越高代表恢复能力越强(年轻/训练有素者较高): A higher adaptation coefficient means a stronger recovery capacity (higher in younger and well-trained athletes)
map.峰值前训练易累积疲劳，峰值后训练超量收益衰减: Training before the peak tends to accumulate fatigue; training after the peak has diminishing supercompensation benefit
map.模型为简化经验估算，实际受睡眠、营养、压力等影响: The model is a simplified empirical estimate; real results are also affected by sleep, nutrition, and stress
map.本工具纯前端计算，结果供训练计划参考: This tool computes entirely in the browser; results are for training-plan reference
map.训练-疲劳-恢复的负荷周期。: The load cycle of training, fatigue, and recovery.
map.按 rTSS 与恢复日排超量恢复窗口，避免连训致过度训练综合征。: Schedule the supercompensation window by rTSS and recovery days to avoid overtraining syndrome from back-to-back sessions.
map.大负荷周后接减载周（量降 40–60%），促成超量恢复。: Follow a high-load week with a deload week (volume cut 40-60%) to promote supercompensation.
map.会过度训练，须周期化。: That leads to overtraining; periodization is required.
map.静息心率升、HRV 降、成绩退、情绪差并发，应降载并延长恢复。: Rising resting heart rate, falling HRV, declining performance, and poor mood occurring together mean you should reduce load and extend recovery.
